title: Zesty Crisp Mexican Chicken Skewers
description: A nutty and crisp Oaxacan dish featuring chicken thighs, perfect for a romantic dinner, this recipe is friendly to Buddhist temple dietary preferences by avoiding beef and pork

ingredients.name: chicken thighs
ingredients.notes: boneless, skinless, cut into 1 inch pieces

instructions: Preheat grill to medium high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lime juice, ground cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the chicken skewers for 10 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked through.
While the chicken is cooking, toast the pine nuts in a small dry skillet over medium heat until fragrant.
Chop the toasted pine nuts and mix with chopped cilantro and minced garlic.
Once the chicken is done, brush with additional lime juice and sprinkle with the pine nut and cilantro mixture.
Serve the chicken skewers hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
